quality_guards: Slip risk depends on flooring, contamination, cleaning, footwear, lighting, route design, behaviour and maintenance.
Work-at-height risk depends on task, height, surface, access equipment, weather, supervision and competence.
Confined-space risk depends on atmosphere, isolation, geometry, contents, ventilation, competence and rescue readiness.
Cylinder risk depends on substance, pressure, container condition, storage, transport, detection and emergency readiness.
Leptospirosis risk depends on reservoirs, water contamination, skin integrity, occupation, rainfall and timing.
Toxoplasmosis risk depends on food, soil, cat-faeces, pregnancy, immunity, animal contact and timing.
Japanese-encephalitis risk depends on destination, season, itinerary, mosquito exposure, age and vaccination.
Magnet risk depends on size and strength, accessibility, design, user behaviour, number ingested and treatment delay.
Water-bead risk depends on bead expansion, hydration, accessibility, age, supervision and treatment delay.
Laser risk depends on device, distance, aircraft phase, cockpit exposure, crew and response.
Each family is context-specific and is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
